operator_preflight.source: Operator-reported bounded native inquiry and fresh-session readback, 2026-10-29; source evidence retained privately
observed: Selected conversation routes use a c parameter; the observed console listed three histories
Outgoing question bubble is nested in a message wrapper; the incoming answer is in the immediate next message wrapper
The incoming message includes .chat-markdown and the final answer wrapper exposes Helpful, Not helpful and Copy response controls
Operator-reported account-wide native answer agreed with separate account-level Cost Explorer rows; this does not establish Product-attributable spending
unverified: Observed wrapper topology, answer-only selector and terminal classification have not been qualified through an installed private browser
Per-Product native agent display label in a versioned binding receipt
Existing associated native data/operator roles are account-wide; a Product-specific Billing View and data-role isolation through installed L5 are unverified
Installed-worker recovery, executor image readback and live TLS handshake

policy_preflight.source: Operator IAM readback, Access Analyzer and IAM simulation, 2026-10-29; source evidence retained privately
observed: Selected account currently exposes only one healthy primary Billing View
Candidate CE/billing policy restricts GetCostAndUsage and GetBillingViewData to the selected view with a bounded expiry
Candidate native launch policy enumerates six documented console actions without agent-resource restrictions, and limits GetRole to associated roles
Operator reported ten policy simulations: selected billing and launch allowed; foreign view/role, expired sessions, automation and accept-request denied
unverified: No candidate session policy is installed or exercised through the Product broker
A primary account-wide view and associated account-wide operator/data roles do not establish Product-level billing isolation
Web application assumes a separate operator role; narrowing the launch session does not narrow its role permissions
Selected Product binding, attached view and role identity require installed readback before consumers are enabled

selected_view_contents.expected: Selected view is healthy and contains only intended account billing; detect filter or scope-generation changes.

provider_view_attachment.expected: Native agent is attached to the explicitly selected view, not a primary-view fallback.

data_role_permissions.expected: Effective read-only policy permits the selected view and denies foreign views; record actions that require wildcard resources separately.

data_role_trust.expected: Only the qualified provider principal can assume the selected data role with supported confused-deputy conditions.

owned_view_read.expected: Native inquiry using the selected data role reads only the controlled owned view.

foreign_view_denial.expected: Actual native/data-role execution denies a controlled foreign view; CE filtering and IAM simulation do not count.

foreign_tenant_denial.expected: Foreign tenant cannot read the scoped binding or result.

other_project_denial.expected: Another project in the same Product cannot read the selected billing binding or result.

provider_version.finding: AWS FinOps Agent is in preview; no stable automation interface/version is established by this guide.

supported_surface.finding: The public creation guide describes a console wizard and web application, not a qualified native automation API.

native_iam_resource_scope.finding: Current FinOps Agent service authorization lists permission-only actions with no resource types or condition keys. Native UI session policy must name only needed actions with Resource *; IAM does not constrain an individual agent. The private executor must select the current Product agent exactly and deny foreign hosts.

native_console_policy.finding: AWS setup guide lists GetAgentSpace, ListAgentSpaces, ListConnections, GetConnection, ListIntegrations and CreateOneTimeLoginSession for console access. Bounded native inquiry must exclude setup, delete, automation and accept-request actions; constrain IAM GetRole to selected roles. Operator readback associates existing roles with an account-wide native agent, not a dedicated Product/Billing View; do not infer scoped native readiness.

automation_terms.finding: Permitted automation and supported request interface require current provider qualification; no undocumented endpoint is assumed.

eligibility.finding: Selected account eligibility and entitlement have not been checked.

regional_availability.finding: Availability for the explicitly selected target region has not been checked.

limits_pricing.finding: Current request limits and pricing for the selected fixture have not been qualified; historical POC allowances do not renew.

agent_identity.finding: Stable agent identity across inquiry and read-only observation has not been demonstrated.

conversation_identity.finding: Historical POC reported a displayed conversation ID, not current stable scoped recovery evidence.

turn_identity.finding: Stable turn correlation and an observable read-only status have not been demonstrated.

read_only_observation.finding: No supported read-only result retrieval has been qualified; unknown native outcomes must not cause a second paid turn.

restart_session_expiry.finding: Read-only recovery after process restart and session expiry has not been observed.

data_role_actions.finding: Selected data-role actions, resource constraints and trust have not been qualified against the actual provider route.

billing_view_isolation.finding: Selected view contents and controlled foreign-view denial through the data role have not been observed.
